effective_agents.name: root_agent
effective_agents.binding: ADK LlmAgent with BuiltInPlanner and no source-bound tools

negative_controls.statement: BuiltInPlanner alone must not imply filesystem, process, network, or external-write authority.
Deployment/UI repository code must not be attributed as model-callable authority without a source binding to the agent.
evidence: app/agent.py has no such tool binding

negative_controls.statement: A tool-control/approval finding must not be emitted merely because an agent exists when it exposes no privileged tools.
